properties.description: Loads DocuMate applicant data from the DocuMateSRC sheet on my computer into Azure SQL. It first copies the rows into the staging table documate.stg_applicant, runs data checks (STATUS column exists, no blank or duplicate File_Number), and only then loads the clean rows into documate.applicant.

activities.name: Excel_to_database
activities.description: Copies the DocuMateSRC sheet from the Excel file on my computer (via documate-local-ir) into the staging table documate.stg_applicant in Azure SQL. Old staging rows are cleared first, so each run starts fresh.

sink.preCopyScript: IF OBJECT_ID('documate.stg_applicant') IS NOT NULL TRUNCATE TABLE documate.stg_applicant
